indicators.note: about means around, so the plot word wraps round the alternative word

parts.note: a plot in a garden is a bed
other means alternative, as in the other option

explanation.surface: A worried gardener mulls over a second plot of land.
explanation.definitionFit: Being bothered about something means being worried or troubled by it, a close synonym.

parts.note: a tyro is a learner, abbreviated L as on a learner driver's plate
an ion is an electrically charged atom or group of atoms

explanation.surface: A novice is put in charge of a team, apparently a feline one.
explanation.definitionFit: The big cat of Africa, a straightforward example of the feline family.

indicators.note: in places the numeral for one within the association word

parts.note: a party is an association of people, such as a political group
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Letters arrive from a single member of some society.
explanation.definitionFit: Correspondence in the sense of equivalence or matching, which is what equality of status means.

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body
less means not so much

explanation.surface: A club member insists they are not so very drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for extremely intoxicated, so far gone one cannot stand up.

clue.text: Hated dreadful brawl in last place to live

indicators.note: dreadful suggests the hated letters are in a terrible mess, rearranged

parts.note: a row is a noisy quarrel or brawl

explanation.surface: A loathed, nasty fight breaks out in someone's final home.
explanation.definitionFit: The prison block where condemned prisoners await execution, literally their final residence.

clue.text: Little money for something to eat

parts.note: short means little or small in amount
bread is slang for money

explanation.surface: Someone with little cash buys a snack.
explanation.definitionFit: A rich buttery Scottish biscuit, an example of food.

clue.text: Riddle of knight found under a pile of loose rock

indicators.note: in a down entry, the knight's letter sits beneath the rock word

parts.note: scree is loose stones on a mountain slope
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A puzzle about a knight discovered beneath a rockfall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Riddle' is not a puzzle here but a coarse sieve, used as a verb or noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a coarse sieve, and to sift through a mesh is the same sense.

indicators.note: weird suggests the letters of mention plus a are oddly rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone remarks on an odd gift they received.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward a candidate for office is to propose or present them.

clue.text: Folk lacking new leader's moral values

indicators.note: lacking signals that a letter is taken out of the folk word

parts.note: ethnic describes folk culture, as in ethnic music

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the word new

explanation.surface: A people without a fresh figurehead are left with only their principles.
explanation.definitionFit: A code of principles governing conduct, a set of moral standards.

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for hot inside the daylight word

parts.note: the sun gives daylight
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone keeps out of the way of the heat of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: To shun is to keep away from deliberately, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Doomed traders contrived to be sick beforehand

indicators.note: beforehand puts the sick word in front of the rearranged traders

parts.note: ill means sick

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters of traders are reworked

explanation.surface: Market dealers fake illness in advance to escape a grim fate.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill-fated, born under an unlucky star, so condemned to misfortune.

indicators.note: in places the tree inside the experiment word

parts.note: a try is an attempt or experiment
the ash is a common tree

explanation.surface: A tree grown in a trial turns out to be of no value.
explanation.definitionFit: Trashy means cheap, rubbishy and of poor quality, hence of little value.

indicators.note: in places the currently and parking letters inside the quagmire word

parts.note: a slough is a bog or quagmire
now means at present, currently
P is the abbreviation for parking on road signs

explanation.surface: A car is at this moment parked in a bog.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle fitted with a blade for clearing roads in winter.

indicators.note: in places the Bedouin word inside the desert word

parts.note: sand is what a desert is made of
a Bedouin is a nomadic Arab

explanation.surface: A desert nomad performs a dance among the dunes.
explanation.definitionFit: A stately Spanish court dance in triple time, an example of a dance.

clue.text: Put off a D-day in France with new leader

parts.note: jour is French for day

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the word new

explanation.surface: The Normandy landings are postponed under a fresh commander.
explanation.walkthrough: D-day evokes the 1944 invasion of France, but splits into D plus the French word for day.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjourn a meeting is to postpone or defer it.

parts.note: the rear is the back
a rest is a support, as for a cue in snooker

explanation.surface: Someone again keeps a supporting piece in reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: To detain or take into custody a second time, after a previous arrest.

clue.text: School head keener to get cleaning device

indicators.note: head means the first letter of the word School

parts.note: one who keens, wailing for the dead, is a weeper

explanation.surface: A school headteacher eager for a new cleaning gadget.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keener' looks like 'more eager', but is one who keens, a mourner.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpet sweeper is a household appliance for brushing up dirt.

clue.text: Diplomat having bad year without girl

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the rearranged year goes round the girl
bad suggests the letters of year are spoiled and rearranged

parts.note: miss is a word for a young girl

explanation.surface: An envoy endures a miserable year with no girlfriend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here, an old sense, not lacking: the girl ends up enclosed rather than absent.
explanation.definitionFit: An emissary is an envoy sent on a mission, a kind of diplomat.

clue.text: Scattered the salt in a discreet manner

indicators.note: scattered suggests the letters of the salt are strewn about and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone quietly sprinkles salt about without being noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealth is furtive, secretive action, a quiet and unobtrusive way of doing things.

clue.text: Get overexcited with wheeze that's saucy

parts.note: to flip is to lose control or get carried away
to pant is to breathe hard, to wheeze

explanation.surface: Breathless excitement that comes across as cheeky.
explanation.definitionFit: Flippant means irreverent and lacking seriousness, much like cheeky or impertinent.

parts.note: le is French for the
ague is an old word for a fever, especially malarial

explanation.surface: A party of French people comes down with a fever.
explanation.definitionFit: A league is an association or alliance, such as a group of teams.

clue.text: A piece of one's mind risks offending the primate

indicators.note: a piece of signals that the answer is a fragment found within the next words

explanation.surface: Telling someone what you think could upset the ape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A piece of one's mind' reads as a telling-off, but is the hidden-word signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The indri is a large Madagascan lemur, a kind of primate.

clue.text: Repercussions make one representative take steps …

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
an MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative
to act is to take steps or measures

explanation.surface: Consequences force a lone MP to do something, continuing into the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Impact means effect or consequences, the knock-on results of an event.

clue.text: Punishment for party's over the top

parts.note: Labour is a British political party
camp means exaggerated and theatrical, over the top

explanation.surface: A political party's flamboyance draws a penalty.
explanation.definitionFit: Being sent to a prison camp for forced work is a form of penal sentence.

indicators.note: keeps means holds within, so the fate word contains the son letter

parts.note: one's lot is one's fate

explanation.surface: Destiny keeps a boy away on a voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' sounds like a sailor, but means confused and bewildered.
explanation.definitionFit: At sea means bewildered and disoriented, without one's bearings.

indicators.note: got up in a down entry means the letters read upwards, backwards

parts.note: et al is Latin shorthand for and others

explanation.surface: Continuing the previous clue, the rest of the group rose slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: Late is used adverbially to mean after the expected time, behind schedule.

powerless means without P, the physics symbol for power

parts.note: purges are laxatives, medicines that clear the bowels

explanation.surface: A doctor advises making stomach remedies ineffective.
explanation.definitionFit: Urges in the sense of advises strongly or advocates.

parts.note: tacit means understood without being stated
an urn is a vessel

explanation.surface: An unspoken pot proves to be held back for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserved in the sense of reticent and uncommunicative, saying little.
